notes.title: UPDATE VERSION 1.1.0 of Riddled Corpse!!!!!!!!!
notes.content:
Hi guys, Riddled Corpse came back with a new update, I'm sorry I took so long, I added some fix of the problems you guys mentioned many times. I approve for the biggest discount I've made in the game. With the launch of my new game Xenon Valkyre.

-You can now change the type of control, play 2 players with a keyboard and a gamepad.
[img]http://i.imgur.com/RXAhecB.png[/img]

-steamcloud is finally added, all your gold will be stored in the steam servers forever !!

-Disable hud, you can now remove the hud with just one button.(re-older_update)
[img]http://i.imgur.com/uyp99oA.png[/img]
Xenon Valkyrie steam:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/573780

Thanks for supporting this game these years, thanks steam players !!

notes.content:

FINALLY!!! RiddledCorpses for OSX and LINUX,i hope to play out in the next games to windows, OSX and Linux.

compatibility with OSX and Linux systems!!!!!!!!!

when a BOSS dies, it is now much more impressive and cool

[h1]-full screen[/h1]
changes full screen in options. you can change whenever you want with alt + enter

notes.title: Riddled Corpses Update version 1.0.2
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/zsF6TVO.jpg[/img]

--Added new elements suggested by the community and fixed some bugs.

[h1]--bug fixes--[/h1]


[h1]- six lives[/h1]
Fixed a bug that allowed to have more than 6 extra lives , this only it affected in stages 2-6

[h1]-sound options[/h1]
above, sound options, to turn off the sounds, was listened to the sounds of gunfire and some explosions. is now fixed

[h1]-double shoot[/h1]
now use gamepad or mouse
previously, you could shoot with the gamepad and mouse  same time, taking double shot. -_-

[h1]-crashes[/h1]
-fixed the problem that crashes the game in survival mode and arcade mode in pause screen.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/9VFTwYI.jpg[/img]

[h1]--improvements and changes--[/h1]

[h1]-translation[/h1]
-the word "zombi wave" of  HUD has changed "zombie wave"
-again translated game texts and achievements to english.thanks Jesse! :D

[h1]-remove hud[/h1]
This addition is very suggested by the community. Now you can remove the HUD by pressing the H key or "select button" on your gamepad.

[h1]-dynamite and midboss[/h1]
Now when you use the dynamite,this erase all normal enemies and 500HP will be absorbed to midboss.

CGdfc

notes.title: Riddled Corpses Update version 1.0.1
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/4K3mVuA.png[/img]

I have been reading many opinions and suggestions to improve the game, I like to improve and refine the game, fix bugs or add more interesting things.


[h1]--bug fixes--[/h1]


[h1]-Online highscore tabs[/h1]
there is a small error that leaves only the best player and not the other 9 players remaining, the top10
highscore online now work properly.

[h1]-F12 screenshoot[/h1]
key to send screenshoots to steam server and share with friends.
key f12 for screenshoots of steam now work properly.

[h1]-Player name[/h1]
the player's name will appear in the statistics appearing in upgrade stats menu.

[h1]-Error achievement[/h1]
bugs fixed with an achievement


[img]http://i.imgur.com/611DSdy.png[/img]


[h1]--improvements and changes--[/h1]


[h1]-Select stage menu[/h1]
Now you can select the stages in arcade mode. only need finish the previous stage.
you can only select the stage 1 to 5
to get the best score, you must start from the stage1.


[h1]-enemy spawn[/h1]
enemies sometimes appear above the player, attack your life or part of your life energy, from now on you can destroy coffins if you're above them, so do not kill you unjustly.

[h1]-jon easy leveling[/h1]
jon levels requires 50% less gold

[h1]-gamepad buttons[/h1]
Now you can use the LB / LT & RB / RT buttons on your gamepad to use special skills.

[h1]-survival mid boss[/h1]
Now in the first waves only appear the easiest enemies.

CGdfc
